metaDescription: Order custom 22 oz mason jars for your brand. Perfect for drinks, gifts, and events. Shop at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: The 22 oz size hits a sweet spot for custom mason jars — large enough for iced coffee or a generous water serving, yet compact enough for easy handling. Unlike smaller jars that feel more like novelty items, these hold a meaningful volume for daily use at trade shows, employee gifts, or promotional giveaways. The wide mouth accommodates ice cubes and makes screen printing or etching your logo straightforward. Whether you fill them with tea blends or use them as branded tumblers, the 22 oz mason jar offers practical versatility that recipients actually keep.
